thesis: The page is the split-flap arrivals board of one January lockout: each promise is a timestamp that flips into place, and the page lightens from 10:52 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. as the board clears.

signature.name: Split-Flap Night Log
signature.summary: Departure-board flap tiles with a hinge seam, Antonio digits, that flip per character when a moment enters: hero h1 timetable rows, a mini header board mirroring the current moment, SMS bubble stamps, flap-digit price ranges, review job tags, and a 07:00 dawn board in the footer; backgrounds step from lake-night navy to dawn milk after 11:24.

palette.family: Lake Night Navy + Flap-Board Cream + Sodium Amber + Dawn Milk

layoutMoves: Timetable grid: a narrow tabular time column (flap tiles) + wide event column, reused by hero, services board and receipt
Pinned phone right / board left at >=900px for the 10:55 text story; stacked bubbles <640px
Night-to-dawn tone ramp: deep -> mid -> deep -> wipe -> dawn -> paper, never two dark bands touching without a mid step
Letterbox strip 21:9 under the stacked h1, full-bleed
Footer as a cleared cream board at 07:00

motion.intro: Hero time tiles flip per character (30ms/char, 260ms), event words line-mask up 70ms stagger, strip porch glow fades in 900ms; total <=1.1s, any input skips.
stories: 10:55 stack: pinned phone, four SMS bubbles stack in as the header board flips per bubble (55svh per step, no pin <640px)
11:24 wipe: scroll-driven --sw-p wipes night navy to dawn paper while the board flips 11:24->11:30 and receipt lines type in
motion.hover: Hinge-seam hairline grows scaleX 0->1 from left under links and board rows, 200ms, hover:hover only
